pick.counterargument: Growth decelerated against the previous quarter, so the trend in the numbers is already turning.
invalidation: Quarterly revenue growth falling below +47.9%, the rate it was running at the quarter before.
Cash conversion dropping below 1.0×, meaning earnings stop being backed by cash.
A close below the 200-session average, which stood at $20.38 on the decision date.
risks: The most recent filing covers a period ending 2026-10-29, 7 days before the decision date.
One of the four quarters in the trailing year is the fourth quarter, which companies report only as part of the full year; it is derived as the annual figure less the first three quarters.
Point-in-time fundamentals are built from filings accepted up to 2026-11-05.

earnings.basis: the same fiscal quarter's announcement a year earlier (2026-02-24) plus 364 days

pick.rule: Universe: every US-listed common stock on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American — about 4,700 names from Nasdaq Trader's own file. Eligible means: priced at $5 or more, median daily turnover of $20M or more over 60 sessions, at least 253 sessions of history, a 10-Q or 10-K whose period ended within 200 days, close above the 200-session average, volatility inside the day's 85th percentile, debt no more than 6× operating cash flow, no results announced in the last 2 sessions, and no position already open in the stock or a fourth in the same SIC division. Eligible candidates are then ranked on equally weighted z-scores within their sector group, over the signals that are defined for that group. One position per session, held 21 sessions, a twenty-first of capital each, 10 basis points of cost each way. Fundamentals are read as they stood on the decision date, never as they read today. The score is a ranking position among that day's eligible candidates. It is not a probability, a price target, or a forecast of any return.
pick.validation: The held-out window has not been opened. No claim of an edge is made or implied.

sources.fundamentals: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets (twelve quarters), point-in-time by accepted timestamp, topped up from companyfacts for companies that have filed since the newest data set
sources.prices: Massive (Polygon.io) grouped daily bars, splits and dividends

stories.title: Python Project Structure: How to Choose the Right Layout
stories.excerpt: Learn how to structure Python projects: pick between flat and src/ layouts, organize your code, and apply the patterns to CLI, web, and GUI apps.

Your Python project structure, also known as your project layout, is the arrangement of files and directories that determines how your code gets imported, tested, and packaged. Choosing between a flat and a src/ layout depends on the type of project you’re building and the trade-offs you accept.

stories.title: Could potential AI clones of GTA VI force a quicker official port?
stories.excerpt: A former Rockstar tech director thinks the developer is facing new time pressures.
stories.lead:
When it comes to major 3D releases, Rockstar clearly prioritizes console launches over PC ports.

When it comes to major 3D releases, Rockstar clearly prioritizes console launches over PC ports. Credit: Kyle Orland

The rise of AI-powered reverse-engineering tools—which can quickly turn a console game binary into easy-to-port raw code with incredible brute-force efficiency and minimal human effort—might change that kind of “PC can wait” calculus for Rockstar. “I think I would be concerned, if I was Rockstar, that somebody would just take the PS5 version and get AI to change it to PC,” Vermeij told Rock Paper Shotgun.

stories.title: In Maine, a new approach to practicing medicine in the sky
stories.excerpt: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.
stories.lead:
Clipboard in hand, pilot Will Bradbury stands near a helicopter at LifeFlight of Maine's Bangor headquarters. He's running down emergency landing tips with his crew.

"If we need to get out quickly because of smoke or fire, just watch the terrain so that you're not walking uphill into the rotors," he reminds flight nurse Denise Saucier and paramedic Brian Merklin.

The team is getting ready to take off on a medical transport flight. Saucier folds herself into the compact helicopter. She's worked for the air ambulance service for seven years and still calls it a dream job.

stories.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
stories.excerpt: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.
stories.lead:
Six people - four women and two men - are confirmed to have been killed in central Krakow, including a British national. Three victims are Polish and two have not been identified.

Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk said three bodies - two women and one man - were found at the gunman's house when it was searched after the attack.

On Sunday, Polish police confirmed those three victims had been identified as the alleged gunman's 53-year-old father, 52-year-old mother and his sister, who was 21-years-old.

stories.title: UFC's Dana White says he will meet with Trump Monday over offer to be White House press secretary
stories.excerpt: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White.
stories.lead:
WEST PALM BEACH, Fla. — President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White, an announcement unconventional even for the norm-busting president. White said Saturday that he plans to meet with Trump on Monday at the White House.

Trump, while he was at his golf club in Florida, posted on social media that he made the offer to "the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior" to become the Republican president's chief spokesperson.

stories.title: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded
stories.excerpt: Video authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment gunshots rang out in Krakow's main market square.
stories.lead:
Six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman opened fire in central Krakow, Poland's second largest city, on Saturday.

Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows about a dozen people running inside two buildings before a black car with its front window open passes, followed by a police car.

Another video shows the moment that gunshots were heard in the city's main market square.

stories.excerpt: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.
stories.lead:
Vinted and eBay could be included in the list of platforms set to be banned for under-16s, the culture secretary has said.

Lisa Nandy said the government was "looking seriously" at including the retailing websites in the social media ban "in order to keep children safe".

The UK's social media ban for those under the age of 16 is set to come into force in March next year, with children barred from accessing platforms such as Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat.

stories.title: No. 7 UC San Diego Drops Game at No. 3 UCLA
stories.excerpt: The seventh-ranked UC San Diego men's water polo team was defeated 19-9 by third-ranked UCLA Saturday at the Spieker Aquatics Center in Los Angeles.
stories.lead:
With the Bruins leading by just two goals at halftime, they stepped on the gas in the second half and put 14 shots in the net.

Eight different Tritons scored. Freshman Lucas Pearce registered his sixth two-goal game of the season. Seven other players scored single goals for UC San Diego. Christian Hammonds racked up four points with a goal and a trio of assists. Landon Akerstrom and Liam Amburgey each scored a goal and dished out an assist.

The Lancers will wait until Sunday's result of the UC Santa Barbara at Cal State Fullerton game to learn if they won the title outright or will share it with the Gauchos if UCSB wins.
